data.gender_notes: Saravan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God of War and Victory, who leads the army of Lord Shiva. The name Saravan carries the meaning “Lord of the Army” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Saravan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the army and live with faith, good character and purpose.
